name: Walter
source:
Leader of the Jakki Knight Troupe.
He's normally an energetic and friendly guy, but sometimes he can go on rampages with superhuman strength.
Even though knowing he's dangerous [url=/c43962]Levias[/url] saw worth in him and gave him a troupe to command.
He admires [url=/c43961]Gerhart[/url] like an older brother.
